title: Qlik Cloud Permission and Role Change Audit
dataSources: Qlik Cloud audit (`qlik:cloud:audit`) and REST API.
app: Qlik Cloud audit events and the Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:cloud:audit (action="*space.updated*" OR action="*role*")
| stats count as changes, values(action) as actions by user_id
| sort - changes
description: Audits Qlik Cloud events that grant, revoke or modify permissions and roles, giving a change trail for least-privilege reviews and incident investigation.
value: Unreviewed permission changes are a leading cause of data-access incidents; an audit trail for Qlik Cloud supports governance and rollback.
implementation: Ingest Qlik Cloud admin/audit events; schedule daily and alert on privilege grants made outside an approved change window.
visualization: Table of actor by change count with actions, timeline.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who changes access and permissions in Qlik Cloud so unexpected changes can be traced.
